en: A colorized panoramic view over a historic European town with red‑tiled roofs, factory buildings with a tall brick chimney, several church towers rising above the skyline, and a large building complex on a hill in the background. Trees and narrow streets weave between the houses. At the top left the printed caption reads "Blick auf Kamenz i. Sa.", indicating the town being depicted.
